query: select exists(select 1 from stream.stream_table s where s.table_id = $1 or s.changelog_table_id = $1) as "is_stream!", exists(select 1 from iceberg_mirror.shadow_flag f where f.table_id = $1) as "has_shadow!", (select count(*) from iceberg_mirror.data_file d where d.table_id = $1 and d.end_snapshot is null and d.file_size_bytes < $2) as "small_count!"
